info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Project Finance Insights API
info.description: The Project Finance Insights API provides users with detailed information and analytics related to project financing within the trade banking sector. By utilizing this API, developers can retrieve valuable data pertaining to specific projects identified by the parameter provided, enabling them to make informed decisions. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts and project managers seeking to evaluate project viability or assess financial performance. This API empowers users to access crucial financial metrics and project details efficiently, streamlining the project finance management process.

get.summary: Retrieve details for a specific project finance resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to get comprehensive details about a specific project finance resource identified by its unique ID. By providing the resource ID in the request, you can access information such as project status, funding details, and associated teams.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve detailed information about the specified project finance operation. It allows the client to specify necessary parameters to filter and customize the response.
